title: Implementing Computational Law in Wolfram Language for the Governance of Artificial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2608.13958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How do we govern AI systems whose reasoning we cannot fully inspect? Governance does not require understanding a system's reasoning. It requires stating what the system is obliged, permitted, and forbidden to do, and checking whether it complied. I present an implementation of Reified Input/Output Logic, the formalism behind the DAPRECO knowledge base, in Wolfram Language: the core I/O axioms, obligations, permissions, constitutive norms, reified eventualities, and temporal operators. I then test whether GPT-4 can translate English legal statements into the formalism, and report the failures: hallucinated functions, omitted temporal scope, deviation from the formalism, and (in the worst cases) code that runs, reads plausibly, but silently encodes the wrong norm. A case study, an AI guard dog operating under a computational contract, shows how formalized rules can extend from a contract directly into the operational code of an embodied ag

translated_title: 在Wolfram语言中实现计算法以治理人工智能
translated_abstract: 我们如何治理那些我们无法完全检查其推理过程的人工智能系统？治理并不需要理解系统的推理。它要求明确系统被强制、允许和禁止做什么，并检查其是否遵守。我提出了在Wolfram语言中实现Reified Input/Output Logic（DAPRECO知识库背后的形式体系）的方法：包括核心的I/O公理、义务、许可、构成性规范、具体化事件和时间运算符。然后，我测试了GPT-4能否将英文法律陈述翻译成该形式体系，并报告了失败情况：幻觉函数、遗漏时间范围、偏离形式体系，以及（在最坏情况下）代码运行正常、读起来合理，但静默编码了错误的规范。一个案例研究——在计算合同下运行的AI看门狗——展示了形式化规则如何从合同直接扩展到具身代理的操作代码中。
tldr: 本文提出在Wolfram语言中实现Reified Input/Output Logic以治理AI，并通过案例研究展示形式化规则可直接嵌入具身代理的操作代码，同时揭示了GPT-4在翻译法律陈述时的失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an implementation of Reified Input/Output Logic in Wolfram Language for AI governance, demonstrating through a case study how formalized rules can extend directly into embodied agent operational code, while exposing GPT-4's failure modes in translating legal statements.
